meaning: Named calls/aggregations occur in successfully evaluated expressions with nonempty original results. This is expression coverage, not instrumented node visitation or branch coverage.
default_profile_meaning: Every stable name occurs in the actual Go AST of a successful default-profile expression with a nonempty final result. This is query-expression evidence, not instrumented node visitation or branch coverage. Original witness provenance is separate from candidate-execution/source-equivalence attribution.
